meta.text: Those four decisions collapse into three levers, and this is the mental model I want you carrying into every scenario question. Lever one: the engine — Photon on or off. Lever two: the cluster shape — node type, worker count, and the autoscaling minimum and maximum. Lever three: the lifecycle — a job cluster versus an all-purpose cluster, plus the auto-termination setting. Engine, shape, lifecycle. Those three levers jointly determine both the runtime and the bill.
